action.text: Task: Add regression tests for port access on urlsplit/urlparse results. Implementation (parse.py:177-185): port property checks isdigit()+isascii(), raises ValueError for non-digit/non-ASCII, then checks 0<=port<=65535. Error at .port access, not construction. Empty port→None. Cases covered. Mutation check: detect.error_class fails because assertRaises(ValueError) also catches subclasses. Fix: add assertIs(type(ctx.exception), ValueError) in test_port_boundary_and_error_details for both str and bytes loops. Then doc file.
